wish: someone should make a tool that measures real distances on images
spec:
Open a photo, drag a reference line over something of known length and type that length; then add lines and areas and read their real size.
Drag dots with a magnifier for precision; lines show length, areas show real area in the reference unit (mm, cm, m, in, ft).
It does not correct perspective: measurements are true only on the same flat surface as the reference, and the photo never leaves the device.
notes: Sample is an A4 sheet with a bank card; the test sets the sheet width as reference and checks the card width (85.6 mm). Photo is read locally via FileReader; nothing is stored except the last reference length and unit.
